defects.defect: Data model objects and field mappings each data stream needs (storefront, review, refund, gift certificate, orders DMOs plus source-to-DMO maps) are folded into the DataStreamDefinition rows instead of listed in Section 9, so the 7-row change set understates what must be built and deployed. This is disclosed only in Open decision 7.
defects.skill_gap: None exists. SKILL.md and org-verification.md do not cover Data 360 metadata composition (a stream needs its DMO and mapping components).

defects.defect: The whole Orders_Ingestion_API / Orders_DataStream path depends on an external Heroku Orders API that exists only in AskCoworker 'prior session' output and cannot be verified. It is labelled reported-by-AskCoworker and made Conditional, but it still sits in the inventory as two Creates with an assumed schema (order_id, storefront_id, order_date, status).
defects.skill_gap: None exists. There is no rule on whether a Create may rest on an external system that only AskCoworker reports.

defects.defect: Field-level Read for the connector permission set on the streamed fields (Rating__c, Status__c, Type__c, Storefront__c) was not queried, although an allowed FieldPermissions SELECT could have settled it. It was deferred to manual verification instead.
defects.skill_gap: SKILL.md's verify-with-org-query guidance covers this in general, but nothing tells the run to check FLS for a Data 360 connector user specifically.
